title: Paloma and the Static
author: Emrys Fairweather
blurb: Silas Iversen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
